mentions.name: World's smallest maze-solving neural network
mentions.description: An experiment to build the world's smallest maze-solving neural network; the current champion model is just 14 bytes and solves 96.5% of unseen mazes up to 21x21, with an interactive website to try it and a work-in-progress write-up.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Trying to make the world’s smallest maze solving neural network. Why? Because it’s fun. Why aren’t you?

Current champion model is 14 bytes - it solves 96.5% of unseen mazes upto 21x21.

Try it yourself on the website. Also a work in progress write up at [1]
